requirements.text: Understand operating systems, relational databases, networking concepts, and client-server architectures.
Demonstrate familiarity with concurrent computing concepts and file system management.
Understand software development lifecycles and quality assurance methodologies.
Apply analytical thinking and numerical problem-solving skills to investigate software behavior.
Use programming or scripting languages such as Python, C++, Perl, or Shell scripting.
Troubleshoot technical issues and identify root causes effectively.
Communicate technical information clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborate effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
Use AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly for learning, coding, test design, and documentation while protecting confidential information.
Evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, reliability, security, and relevance before applying them to engineering work.
Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in computer science, electrical engineering, mathematics, or a related field.
Junior or senior standing, or graduate-level student.
Previous coursework, academic projects, research, or internship experience related to software development, software testing, or system engineering is preferred.
